import io
import pytest
from werkzeug.wrappers import Request
from werkzeug.exceptions import BadRequestKeyError


class TestRequestFromValues:
    def test_basic_usage(self):
        data = b'foo=Hello+World&bar=baz'
        req = Request.from_values(
            input_stream=io.BytesIO(data),
            content_length=len(data),
            content_type='application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
            method='POST'
        )
        assert req.form['foo'] == 'Hello World'
        assert req.form['bar'] == 'baz'

    def test_missing_content_type(self):
        data = b'foo=Hello+World&bar=baz'
        req = Request.from_values(
            input_stream=io.BytesIO(data),
            content_length=len(data),
            method='POST'
        )
        assert req.form['foo'] == 'Hello World'
        assert req.form['bar'] == 'baz'

    def test_empty_form_data(self):
        req = Request.from_values(
            content_type='application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
            method='POST'
        )
        assert req.form == {}

    def test_multipart_form_data(self):
        data = (
            b'--foo
'
            b'Content-Disposition: form-data; name="test"; filename="test.txt"

'
            b'file contents
--foo--'
        )
        req = Request.from_values(
            input_stream=io.BytesIO(data),
            content_length=len(data),
            content_type='multipart/form-data; boundary=foo',
            method='POST'
        )
        assert req.files['test'].filename == 'test.txt'
        assert req.files['test'].read() == b'file contents'

    def test_missing_boundary(self):
        data = (
            b'--foo
'
            b'Content-Disposition: form-field; name=foo

'
            b'Hello World
'
            b'--foo
'
            b'Content-Disposition: form-field; name=bar

'
            b'bar=baz
--foo--'
        )
        req = Request.from_values(
            input_stream=io.BytesIO(data),
            content_length=len(data),
            content_type='multipart/form-data',
            method='POST'
        )
        assert req.form == {}

    def test_invalid_content_type(self):
        data = b'foo=Hello+World&bar=baz'
        with pytest.raises(BadRequestKeyError):
            Request.from_values(
                input_stream=io.BytesIO(data),
                content_length=len(data),
                content_type='invalid/content-type',
                method='POST'
            )

    def test_large_form_data(self):
        data = b'foo=' + b'a' * 10000
        req = Request.from_values(
            input_stream=io.BytesIO(data),
            content_length=len(data),
            content_type='application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
            method='POST'
        )
        assert req.form['foo'] == 'a' * 10000

    def test_shallow_request(self):
        data = b'foo=Hello+World&bar=baz'
        req = Request.from_values(
            input_stream=io.BytesIO(data),
            content_length=len(data),
            content_type='application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
            method='POST',
            shallow=True
        )
        assert req.shallow is True

    def test_charset_override(self):
        data = b'foo=Hello+World&bar=baz'
        req = Request.from_values(
            input_stream=io.BytesIO(data),
            content_length=len(data),
            content_type='application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
            method='POST',
            charset='utf-8'
        )
        assert req.form['foo'] == 'Hello World'
        assert req.form['bar'] == 'baz'
